svg.title: Attention vs State Space
svg.desc: Attention compares every position with every other, paying a cost quadratic in length; state space and recurrent models carry a state forward and stream at linear cost with constant memory.
svg.text: Re-reading the whole window each time vs carrying a state and updating one step
Every position compared with every other
The KV cache grows with length
Cost and memory on long windows
Compressed into a state, passed on
Linear in T — trained by parallel scan
Only the state updates; the cost
The number of connections scales as T²
A new observation means recomputing the whole window
A single state carries the past
The number of connections scales as T
A new observation updates only the state, once
The longer the window, the heavier real-time updating gets
Well suited to streaming and real-time updates
Attention buys expressiveness at quadratic cost; state space compresses into one state and stays linear.
Where observations keep streaming in, that difference is your operating cost.
Recurrence along time, attention across variates —
designs mixing both blocks are on the rise
Next (S09): Chronos tokenization vs the TimesFM patch decoder — pretraining design.
